regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, graphical abstract, and metadata
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and aggregate gold-catalyzed enynone/alkynylsilane claim. The graphical abstract is a generic transformation, not an experiment-specific run.
Classified the propargyl-ester/alkynylsilane chemistry as the authors' cited 2021 prior work; its proposed three-step rearrangement is context, not a current experiment.

Separated the cited state-of-the-art enynone/gold transformation classes from the generic current enynone-plus-alkynylsilane silylallene proposal. Neither generic panel was assigned a Table 1/2 yield.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 substituents and catalysts do not define unique structures, quantities, or outcomes.
The paper advertises online SI, but workspace SI association remains unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-16, and footnotes a-h
regions.finding: Recorded every optimization condition independently. Entry 15's three solvent trials are separated while retaining the single shared dash/nonviable statement. Shared 1a/2a/DCE conditions and row catalyst, solvent, temperature, time, equivalents/loading, trace, numeric yield, major dimer, and no-reaction overrides are applied row-wise.
Mapped catalyst, loading, temperature, solvent, and no-catalyst narrative to the Table 1 records without creating duplicates.
Mapped the prose to the 3b-3v scope rows shown on page 3, including substituent identities and yields. The TIPS 2r failure is linked to footnote 11 on page 5 rather than inferred as a product row.

unresolved: Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and detection limits.
Table 2 does not report reaction times or operational details.
Entry 15 does not quantify its three solvent trials separately.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 reaction header, products 3b-3w, dotted-box 4a, and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Recorded 22 displayed silylallene rows plus the distinct 1e/2a vinylfuran-4a outcome. All shared charges, catalyst loading, solvent volume, 80 °C condition, isolated yields, 3w 0%/unchanged-reagent recovery, and 4a-only-product statement are product-targeted.
Merged the 1d/2a 3w failure and 1e/2a 4a-only outcome with their matching Table 2 arrows rather than duplicating them.
Classified gold furyl carbene I and beta-gold vinyl cation II as proposed mechanism intermediates, not preparations.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right beginning of Scheme 3 discussion
regions.finding: The 1a/diphenylacetylene experiment starts here and continues visually on page 4; it is one 60 °C, 1 h, 18% record with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Table 2 does not report reaction time, atmosphere, workup, purification, or isolated masses.
The percentages of unchanged recovered 1d/2a are not given.
Scheme 3 omits reactant charges, DCE volume, and yield basis.

regions.finding: Inspected the full proposed I/II cycle and retained it as one mechanism record; generic intermediates are not isolated experiments.
Recorded the distinct 1a + diphenylacetylene 2s experiment with [IPrAu(CH3CN)][SbF6] 5 mol%, DCE, 60 °C, 1 h, and product 5 in 18% reported yield.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left conclusion and associated-content statement
regions.finding: Conclusions add no reaction row. The publisher SI statement does not establish workspace association, so no SI-only procedure or characterization was imported.

regions.region: page 4 right column author/administrative text and references 1-3
regions.finding: Administrative material and bibliography only; cited external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 3 lacks quantities, solvent volume, workup, purification, mass, and yield basis.

regions.region: page 5 references 3-16 excluding chemistry-bearing footnotes 11, 13, and 16
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature context only; external cited experiments were not imported as experiments of this article.

Recorded the explicit failure of enynone 1a with 1-phenyl-2-triisopropylsilylacetylene 2r. Because the footnote does not restate the operating conditions, missing quantities/conditions remain null rather than inherited silently.
Classified cyclopropenation followed by gold-catalyzed cyclopropene-to-allene rearrangement as an alternative proposed mechanism, not an observed current experiment.
Classified the proposed vinyl-cation/electrophilic-cyclization/[1,5]-H-shift route to indene 5 as a mechanism linked to Scheme 3, not separate preparations of III or IV.

unresolved: Footnote 11 omits exact conditions and analytical detection limits.
Intermediates in footnotes 13 and 16 are proposed and not independently observed.
No new standalone preparative experiment occurs in the remaining bibliography.
